summary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into three separate lease agreements with Hightower Phase I Owner, LLC for three industrial buildings in Houston, Texas, for manufacturing, warehouse, and office use. Each lease has an initial term of 123 months with periodic rent escalation and an initial rent abatement period. The leases also include purchase options for the buildings. This is a routine real estate lease agreement, not a special situation event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation elements involved. Filing is classified as Other due to the material definitive agreement nature but lacking any special-situation catalyst.
